rationale: The farmington/final_permit.pdf cover excerpt states that effluent limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in Part I through Part IV, which partially supports locating operative requirements in permit Parts for at least one facility corpus. However, the packet does not establish this operative-source classification for all three listed facilities: only NM0020583 appears in an excerpt, while NM0028762 and NM0000116 are not identified in any selected span. The FY2025 window appears only in purposes/visible_a.md, not in permit-source excerpts, so the packet does not ground that enforceable FY2025 limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in the Parts rather than elsewhere. The fact-sheet and statement-of-basis excerpts are cover or title headers only; they do not establish whether those documents function as supporting rationale for the draft permit or as independent operative effluent limits. Because ACCEPT requires establishing the full operative-Parts versus rationale-fact-sheet/SOB distinction and REJECT requires establishing its negation, and neither burden is met, UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
